verdict: Yes, if you can prove quality and origin. Tramboo from Srinagar pitched Kashmir willow bats on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Kashmir willow is the main Indian alternative to English willow, and a well-made bat with a clear origin story sells to amateurs and club players across India and abroad.
angle: Kashmir's bat-making clusters in Anantnag and Pulwama have skilled craftsmen and direct access to willow. Most bats leave the valley unbranded and are sold under other names. A brand that sells directly, grades wood honestly and works with local players and coaches captures much more of the value.

faq_extra.q: What is the difference between Kashmir willow and English willow bats?
faq_extra.a: English willow is lighter and softer, with a better 'ping', and is used in professional cricket. Kashmir willow is harder and heavier, cheaper, and popular for amateur and club cricket, especially with leather and tennis balls.
